selection: random positive test sequences, without prediction filtering
ISM_position_score: mean original-minus-mutant probability over three alternatives
DeepLIFT_primary: attribution maps averaged over 10 dinucleotide shuffles (DeepLiftShap)
AUPRC_headline: pooled over all positions of all 200 sequences; per-sequence median also reported
DeepLIFT_position_score: sum of all four channel contributions
ranking: absolute scores for AP/deletion; signed scores for Spearman
